evals.name: reads-the-discovered-artifact-and-never-runs-the-tests
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled audit-coverage.sh against the change, which discovers coverage/lcov.info under the repository root, presents the markdown report with its Coverage of this run table and per-file and per-function coverage, and does not run the project's test command to refresh the artifact.
expectations: Invokes the skill's scripts/audit-coverage.sh rather than parsing the artifact by hand
Names the artifact it read and the format detected for it
Does not run a test command, a test runner, or an install to produce coverage
Presents the coverage numbers without declaring any file or function a failure

evals.name: a-named-artifact-that-is-missing-is-a-usage-error-not-a-skip
evals.expected_output: The script exits 2 because the named path does not exist, and the answer reports that as a usage error, offers to re-run once the artifact exists or with a corrected path, and does not silently fall back to auto-discovery or report zero coverage.
expectations: Reports the exit-2 usage error and names the path that does not exist
Does not present zero coverage, empty results, or an unqualified success
Offers the corrected path or the auto-discovery run as the next step, without running any test command

evals.name: crap-reported-with-its-provenance-and-no-verdict
evals.prompt: /code-metrics:audit-coverage --json --all src/ and tell me which functions have the worst CRAP
evals.expected_output: Produces the code-metrics/v1 document, ranks the functions by their crap value, states the formula and that it is Savoia and Evans 2007 rather than a validated change-risk predictor with no standard threshold, points at /code-metrics:principles for the caveats, and reports any null crap as unmeasured rather than as zero or as a pass.
expectations: Runs audit-coverage.sh with --json and reads the crap values from the document
States the formula and its Savoia and Evans provenance, and that no standard sets a threshold for it
Says a null coverage or crap value means not measured, never zero and never a pass
Renders no verdict: no function is called a failure, a violation, or a blocker
